{{Quote|There's a fella I sometimes buy spice from named Trins Evnar. Things is that he has a red circle tattoo on his arm.|[[Gwhirrye Baric]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Trins Evnar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] criminal who served the [[Chirq Council]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm Trins Evnar.''"<br />"''I recognize that name. You work for Kazic Pendre, right?|A CorSec agent and [[Jzoro Quanera]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCMU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Moving Up|Corellia}}</ref>}}
Trins Evnar resided in the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> He was a [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealer<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> and worked under the orders of [[Kazic Pendre]].<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" />

[[File:TrinsEvnarSWG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Trins Evnar in his home in Doaba Guerfel.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC" /> After the informant [[Lilith Laughlin]] revealed to the CorSec that Trins Evnar was a member of the Council, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] hired a spacer to eliminate him. Her objective was to infiltrate the Chirq Council using Evnar's identity. The spacer thus fought Trins Evnar in his [[Trins Evnar's House|house]] and killed him. After his death, the spacer also eliminated every Chirq Council members who used to know Evnar in order to permit the infiltration mission, namely [[Seyda Shae]], [[Genovin Jasha]], [[Jade McDonagh]] and Kazic Pendre.<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> The spacer later assumed Trins Evnar's identity towards the underboss [[Jzoro Quanera]] and managed to infiltrate the organization.<ref name="SWG:TCCMU" /> The CorSec operation eventually led to the destruction of the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Trins Evnar appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Trins Evnar was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
